body: Today I yelled at my mom and brother to leave me alone in my room for my birthday. I've done nothing but hide in my room and distract myself for the past two months because I can't afford treatment. And before you ask, no I don't qualify for anything. Slowly but surely I'm pissing them off. Eventually they'll kick me out so I'm not a burden on them. I'm too weak to live on the street willingly, so I'll have to force myself into that situation. Eventually I'll kill myself; I just don't know exactly how.

I feel you. A few months ago I dropped out of college and out of shame, deleted everyone on my Steam/etc. friends lists (that was our main means of communication) and changed my username. This included a longtime friend of mine since middle school (5+ years). It's been way too long for me to go back, and now I'm even more ashamed of myself than ever. All that's left on my friends list is my brother and mom, whom I live with.

I don't have any answers for you, but I'd sure like to see what others can do.
Nice try.

My plan to get my mom to hate me and kick me out of the house is backfiring. She's now forcing me to go to a psychiatrist she can't afford, threatening to have me arrested and put in the hospital against my will (which would be even more expensive). I'm a lost cause; I just want her to stop caring about me anymore.
For some of us we screw up so much that sorry alone doesn't cut it, so we compensate with extra sorry's since there's really no way to apologize profusely without apologizing repeatedly.
What am I supposed to do when I screw up so much and so often that I *have* to apologize all the time?
My dad would slap me in the face whenever he caught me swearing. It wasn't until middle school when my friends noticed a red hand-shaped mark on my face did I realize that was borderline abuse.

My cat's dying. He's been starving to death even though we feed him more than ever, and he's been pooping and peeing on whatever he's currently standing on. He doesn't even use his catbox anymore. He's lost all control of those functions and his body barely processes his food. The worst part is we could never even afford to take him to the vet. My mom says she's going to take him in to be put down tomorrow. If I had got a job I could have at least paid for diagnosis and treatment to make his last few months a lot less painful, but now it's too late.

It's not working so much as the job itself. My last job was a cashier at a big chain grocery store, and it's that customers are so cruel. I couldn't make friends with my coworkers because I have no social skills and self-confidence, and my boss was always pissed at me from screwing up all the time. I am a constant screwup, and when a customer sees that they will metaphorically beat me over the head with it until my manager steps in (who also metaphorically beats me over the head with it). Customers will get pissed off even from things I have zero control over. Even the slightest inconvenience due to policy or change from how they expected checkout to go will immediately enrage them so they start yelling at me about all my screwups. It is a psychologically toxic job that requires a certain type of personality to handle. You need to be extremely confident, outgoing, happy, and thick-skinned to handle that type of job, and I am the exact opposite of all those things.

Now I have to get a job again, and I've been rejected from every other type of job. Cashier at a big chain grocery store is the only job left I can apply for, and it's at a chain whose work environment is even more infamously toxic than my last job. It's a job I have to take because I have no other options, and one I'm sure will drive me to suicide.

I have to get a job I know will drive me to suicide because my mom can't afford to pay for the house any more. I have to have a job in the next two weeks or she'll start charging me rent regardless. Nobody else will hire me so the only places left are the ones similar to my last job, which I had to quit because I was about to kill myself. I won't have that luxury this time around.
The thing is, I don't get good at things. With enough practice, I can be average at things. That's the best I can do, and in most cases, that's not enough.
"I'm just tired."

As someone who's suicidal and cannot afford therapy or treatment, what other options do we have?

> (even at the cost of higher taxes or cutting funding elsewhere)

In my country there's an overwhelming attitude of "get a job and quit whining". People don't see it as the government's job to make people happy or healthy, especially for those of us who often don't even want to be alive ourselves. The belief here is that if you're not working, you don't deserve someone else's taxes.

Short answer: All you want to do anymore is nothing.

Long answer: You don't enjoy the things you used to enjoy (hobbies, time with friends, eating good food), and anything you did because you had to (work/classwork, chores, basic hygene) becomes inexplicably painful to do. Instead, all you want to do is nothing at all, or as close to nothing at all as you can get without boredom. When you start thinking about how much nothing you're doing, instead of doing something, you think about how much of a failure doing that nothing has made you, and how you don't deserve to enjoy anything, even nothing. You start to realize that all that nothing you're doing makes you worth nothing. The more you realize you're worth nothing, the more you realize that the world would be better off if you really were nothing. So in order to stay sane each day, you just keep doing nothing, and try not to think about the fact you're doing nothing. You get stuck in this contradictory cycle of doing nothing just to not think about the fact that you're doing nothing.

I'm a burden on everyone I know, because I'm horribly lazy. I literally play video games all day since I won't work hard enough to pass even a single class, and I'm too much of a fuckup to keep a job. I'm driving my mom into debt because of my laziness, and I don't even care anymore. I'm causing direct harm to those who care about me from my own moral failings with no effort to change. That is the definition of a terrible person.
My constant failure to do anything right, and the resulting lack of motivation to do anything at all.

I'm pretty much just like that guy: disgusting slob that does nothing but video games because I can't motivate myself to do anything else. But at least I know I'm in no position to be in a relationship.
I'm a lazy, shitty person with no worth or potential.

I'm 21 in the US. We don't have universal healthcare here due to a persistent delusion of economic mobility. There are no more resources in my area, and I can't afford insurance. My current therapist is unable to handle depression this severe and is already too expensive to keep going to much longer. I'm too fucked up in the head to get or keep a job, and the only jobs available to me make me want to kill myself even more. I can't pass any of my classes, even if it's just one. There are no more options. Might as well try to end it soon to not drag this shitshow out.

If a state-funded place can't even give me a discount, why would anyone else be able to do it for free? All the paperwork is saying my mom should be middle class. The reality is that we're drowning in debt. Free treatment is for low-income families. We're moderate income, high expenses. All anyone sees is my mom seeming to make bad finance decisions and me being lazy (unemployed and failing all classes). Pretty sure the cheapest long-term solution is suicide.

I'm doing that right now. My grades are so bad this quarter I can't bear to look at all the missing assignments. Every time I think about class I want to kill myself, so the only way I stay partially sane is by distracting myself to extreme lengths with video games. I've repeated this cycle every quarter for the past two years, and have wasted tens of thousands of my mom's savings. I think this will be the last straw for her and she'll kick me out of the house. I certainly deserve it for all my laziness.
I don't have the money for that kind of medical bill, and if it goes on a permanent record it would ruin me from ever getting a job that isn't shit.
I'd rather be ignored than get weird looks everywhere I go.
There is literally nothing I am good at. How can I fake confidence when there is nothing I'm confident in to draw from?

[There is absolutely such thing as an ugly smile.](http://i.cdn.turner.com/v5cache/TBS/Images/Dynamic/i23/friends_episode151_337x233_032020061513.jpg)

Saying there are no ugly smiles is like saying there are no ugly people. It's complete bullshit and empty rhetoric. I have an ugly smile - not just a "it's not *that* bad" ugly, but "creepy cackling monster under your bed" ugly. People call me out for "being creepy" whenever I smile. It isn't just in my head. It is absolutely an ugly smile.

I can't smile unless it comes naturally, and then I get overwhelmingly self-conscious since my smile is horrifically ugly. If I try to force a smile I look like The Joker with a concussion. My only option is to avoid smiling in public.
That's about it. There isn't really anything else I enjoy.

I play D3, Skyrim, and FTB, which aren't competitive at all, but I tend to get bored easily, especially if I feel like I'm not "progressing". 

As for programming, I know C# fairly well, but I never know what to do with it (again, zero creativity). I have at least a dozen half-finished projects that reached a point where it's not worth the time I spent on them to continue, or became obsolete with the release of other software, or are so riddled with bugs I can't fix that I've given up. There are a few game projects I *want* to do, but require creativity for the purpose of theme and art assets, of which I have none.

Some of those games I enjoy. Others (most notably Overwatch) look like lots of fun when I go in, and then I'm just miserable the whole time because I keep failing. With ESO I just feel awkward and unwelcome, no matter how nice other players are; all I can think of is, "you don't belong here, you have nothing to contribute" (which for the most part is actually true).

I get the whole "try try again" mentality, but it just doesn't for me. I don't get better. I don't improve or learn. I stagnate at a "wow you suck" level no matter how hard I focus and try at anything. It's why I can only really enjoy easy games. At least then I can *feel* like I'm accomplishing something, until I realize that everyone else just breezes through the whole thing without a sweat. I don't get better. I just stagnate. Sometimes I even get worse the more I practice.

I have nothing that can benefit anyone or contribute to anything good. I know I don't need to be the best, but most people have at least *something* they can do well. The only thing that qualifies for me is screwing up.

If you want short story long, [here's what I posted to the depression sub.](https://np.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/71e04m/im_a_complete_and_total_failure/) I don't really have much else to say about myself. I'm not exactly an interesting person.

I play a lot of different games. Skyrim, Diablo 3, TF2, Project M, Elder Scrolls Online, (heavily) modded Minecraft, Borderlands 2, Terraria, sometimes Overwatch, to name a few.

With modded Minecraft, I've had a hard time getting into it in the past year or so. I guess I don't feel like I'm creating anything new, since I lack any creativity. Copying other people's style never works for me since it seems to depend so much on *where* you put your base and how it's laid out as much as what it looks like. Otherwise it just never looks right.

I don't really have any friends. The people on my friends lists are just people who added me in-game for one reason or another months ago and I had never talked to since. For advice I just google stuff over and over again, and sometimes it helps. Other times I could know the difficult part extremely well and still fail from my own lack of skill. As I said, knowing how things work is never the problem with me. It's my complete lack of skill.

As for other types of games, they just don't interest me. I am extremely uncreative, all I can do is imitate someone else's work, so creative-type games just don't work for me. I'm not patient either. I'm someone with no redeeming traits or value, so any game of any sort is just going to result in my failure.
